entity: SAS Anne Le Hénanff Conseils et Communication
period: 2016-2025 (created 18 April 2016; dissolved by sole shareholder 23 May 2025; RCS radiation 5 September 2025)
detail: Digital/communications and management consultancy (NAF 7022Z) based in Vannes (Morbihan). She was salaried president; in her HATVP declaration she lists herself as 'présidente salariée' of this company from 01/2020 to 01/2024 (net remuneration: 2020 €6,262; 2021 €6,258; 2022 €1,899; 2023 €0; 2024 €0). The company's INSEE establishment was closed 25 July 2025 and the firm was dissolved/liquidated, with Anne Le Hénanff acting as sole shareholder and liquidator per the legal dissolution notice. (Note: the RNE/registry lists the manager under the name 'Anne LE DIRACH', the same person; the dissolution legal notice names 'Madame Anne LE HENANFF' as associée unique and liquidateur.)
